body.name: nuisance_hat
body.def: \((\widehat p_{k},\widehat g_{k},\widehat m_{k},\widehat r_{k})\) are boundary-corrected local-polynomial estimators of degree at least \(\lceil s\rceil\), trained outside \(\mathcal I_{k}\) with bandwidth \(h_{n}=n^{-1/(2s)}\); the two density estimators are normalized and stabilized on \([\varrho_n,\varrho_n^{-1}]\).
